strings.copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
strings.err_network: Can't reach Bageo. Is it still running?
strings.err_try_again: That didn't work. Please try again.
strings.token_body: This console is protected by a password.
strings.setup_title: Welcome! Three steps and your phone answers itself
strings.setup_1_d: Add your Gemini API key and your name.
strings.setup_2_d: Plug in the phone with the app installed by USB and wait until it shows “Ready for calls”. After that you can unplug it: it switches to Wi-Fi by itself.
strings.setup_3_d: Choose where call summaries go, such as Telegram or Discord.
strings.empty_body: Plug in your phone and call its number. The call shows up here with a summary and the recording.
strings.d_pending: Writing the summary… this takes about half a minute after the call.
strings.d_live: The call is still going. The summary and the conversation appear after it ends.
strings.d_src_fallback: The summary service did not answer, so this is only a rough note.
strings.d_src_nokey: No summary service is set up.
strings.ap_time_unconfirmed: The caller never confirmed this time read back; check it with them before you answer
strings.ap_working: Working… (up to about 90 seconds when a text is sent)
strings.sms_c_old_app: the phone app is too old
strings.sms_c_busy: the same text is already being sent
strings.sms_c_no_permission: the phone app may not send texts
strings.sms_c_radio_off: the phone's radio is off (airplane mode)
strings.sms_c_generic_failure: the carrier did not take the text
strings.sms_c_exception: the phone app ran into an error
strings.sms_c_bad_request: the number or the text was not accepted
strings.sms_c_sim_not_found: the chosen SIM card is not in the phone
strings.cal_pick_title: Which calendar should it go in?
strings.cal_pick_body: Your choice is remembered. Press “Change” to pick another.
strings.cal_hint_office365: Outlook with a work or school account
strings.cal_hint_apple: iPhone, iPad, Mac: open it and tap Add
strings.cal_hint_ics: Any other calendar app: import the file
strings.ap_res_yes_sent: Accepted, and the caller got a text
strings.ap_res_no_sent: Declined, and the caller got a text
strings.ap_res_sms_none: This number can't take texts, so call them back yourself
strings.ap_res_hidden: Hidden number: the caller can't be told
strings.ap_call_dialing: The AI is calling them back…
strings.ap_call_no_answer: The AI called back; nobody answered
strings.ap_call_cut: The AI's call-back was cut off
strings.ap_call_failed: The AI's call-back couldn't be placed
strings.ap_call_no_phone: No call-back: no phone is connected to place it
strings.ap_call_send_failed: No call-back: the phone didn't get the request
strings.ap_call_queued: The AI calls once its earlier call-back to the same number has ended
strings.ap_call_answered: The AI's call-back got through and the caller was told
strings.ap_call_not_callable: No call-back: this number can't be called back (abroad, toll-free, premium or a short code)
strings.tr_listen_h: The whole call: the caller and the AI together.
strings.tr_vm_h: Only the message the caller left.
strings.d_live_wait: Once the AI picks up, what both sides say shows up here.
strings.d_tr_need: This phone has no offline translation for {langs} yet. Download it to translate on the phone without using quota.
strings.d_live_phone: The call is still going. The summary appears after it ends.
strings.d_tr_fail: Couldn't translate: the phone has no offline translation for this language and the summary service didn't answer.
strings.end_ai_fail: The AI could not connect, so the call was hung up.
strings.end_voicemail: The AI failed and the call went to voicemail.
strings.end_hidden: Hidden number: a refusal announcement was played and the call ended. The AI did not answer.
strings.end_blocked: Blocked number: the “not available” announcement was played and the call ended. The AI did not answer.
strings.end_spam: Judged a sales or scam call, so the AI kept the caller talking to waste their time.
strings.end_normal: The AI answered and talked, and the call ended normally.
strings.end_call_waiting: It came in during another call, and the phone turned it away as busy (no AI).
strings.d_block_body: Calls from this number will be turned away. The AI will not answer them.
strings.d_notfound: This call was not found. It may be older than the time recordings are kept.
strings.d_scam_none: Not judged a sales or scam call
strings.d_scam_released: Judged a sales or scam call at first, then let go as an ordinary call
strings.d_fb_q: Was this right? Your answer is used for this number's next calls.
strings.d_fb_done: Marked. This number's next calls are judged with it.
strings.d_fb_done_hidden: Marked. A hidden number is not remembered.
strings.ev_persona_stall_released: Let go as an ordinary call
strings.f_scam_blind: Check every call for sales and scams
strings.f_scam_blind_h: On: new tricks are caught too, for a little more usage. Off: only calls with common sales or scam words are checked.
strings.ev_ai_fail_quota: Gemini quota used up or spending cap reached
strings.ct_empty_body: Add people yourself, or import contacts from your phone, Google or Outlook. When they call you see their name, and the AI knows who it is.
strings.ct_note_help: The AI sees this when they call, e.g. “my sister”, “landlord”, “colleague”.
strings.ct_delete_body: Calls from these numbers will show only the number again.
strings.ct_need_phone: Enter at least one phone number.
strings.ct_exists: This number is already saved for {name}.
strings.ct_imp_drop: Drop a file here, or click to choose one
strings.ct_imp_formats: vCard, CSV, Excel, Word and text files all work. PDFs and pictures are read by Gemini, which needs your Gemini API key. Up to 10 MB.
strings.ct_imp_skipped: {n} entries without a name or number were left out.
strings.ct_imp_none: No contacts with a phone number were found in this file.
strings.ct_imp_by_ai: Gemini read this file: check the names and numbers before you import.
strings.err_contact_exists: This number is already saved for another contact.
strings.err_invalid_contact: Enter a name and at least one phone number.
strings.err_too_many_contacts: At most 10,000 contacts can be kept.
strings.err_contacts_save_failed: The contacts could not be written to disk.
strings.err_need_gemini_key: This kind of file is read by Gemini: add the Gemini API key in Settings first.
strings.err_unsupported_file: This kind of file cannot be read. Save it as .xlsx, .csv, .vcf or PDF and try again.
strings.err_file_too_large: The file is larger than 10 MB.
strings.err_ai_failed: Gemini could not read the file.
strings.err_too_many_rows: This file is too big (at most 100,000 rows). Split it, or keep only the contact columns.
strings.err_import_failed: Reading the file stopped. Try again.
strings.s_meta: Changes apply from the next call.
strings.saved: Saved. Applies from the next call.
strings.notify_follows_ui: Notifications are now in {lang} too (settings: Notification language).
strings.set_not_loaded: The settings are still loading. Try again in a moment.
strings.sec_will_remove: Will be removed when you save.
strings.g_basics_d: The few things the AI needs before it can answer your phone.
strings.f_language_h: The language the AI speaks with callers.
strings.f_notify_lang_h: The language of the notifications and summaries you read. It does not change the language the AI speaks to callers.
strings.f_simlang_h: Calls to this SIM start in the main language; a call from abroad uses the second language set for its region, else its country's language. Needs the phone app 1.0 or newer.
strings.sl_empty: Nothing set: every call starts in the language above.
strings.f_owner_h: The name callers use for you. The AI uses it when it talks about you.
strings.f_owner_aliases: Other names callers use for you
strings.f_owner_aliases_h: An English name, a nickname and so on. One per line, up to 10. The AI knows they mean you.
strings.style_assistant_d: Says it is your AI assistant and takes a message.
strings.style_persona_d: Answers as if it were you, without agreeing to anything on your behalf.
strings.f_key_link: Get a key at Google AI Studio
strings.f_model_h: The model the AI talks with. You rarely need to change it.
strings.f_voice_h: The preview plays three sample lines in the language chosen above.
strings.f_enabled_h: Off: calls are picked up and ended at once. To let the phone ring as usual, use “Switch to normal phone” on the System page or in the phone app.
strings.f_ring_h: Rings a little before answering, like a person would. 0 = at once.
strings.f_normal_max_h: 3 to 30. Shortly before the limit the AI wraps up politely and hangs up.
strings.f_prewarm: Get the AI ready while the phone rings
strings.f_prewarm_h: Recommended: the AI speaks the moment it picks up. Off: callers wait 1 to 3 seconds.
strings.f_unknown_h: On: callers without a caller ID get the AI like everyone else. Off: they hear a short “not available” announcement and the call ends.
strings.f_barge_h: The AI stops and listens when the caller talks over it. Not every phone can do this; Bageo checks by itself.
strings.f_vad: Let Gemini decide when the caller has finished
strings.f_vad_h: Recommended. Off: loudness alone decides instead.
strings.f_reply_lang_h: The AI switches only when the caller clearly speaks another language in full sentences. A quick “hello” or unclear words don't count.
strings.f_status_h: A note about right now, such as where a courier should leave a parcel. The AI mentions it only when it fits the call.
strings.f_status_ph: e.g. Deliveries: please leave the parcel at the front desk.
strings.f_amb_h: Adds a quiet room sound behind the AI's voice, so it sounds like a real person answering.
strings.g_spam_d: What the AI does when the caller is clearly selling something or running a scam.
strings.f_stall_h: The AI acts interested and keeps asking for details to waste their time. It gives out nothing and agrees to nothing. Off: it declines and hangs up.
strings.f_stall_max_h: 3 to 30. Longer calls use more of your Gemini quota.
strings.f_stall_model_h: Empty = the same model as normal calls.
strings.g_prompt_d: A few short answers help the AI sound like you. All optional.
strings.f_prompt_ph: Empty: the built-in prompt is used
strings.f_prompt_h: Filled in, it replaces the talk style and local habits. Each answer style keeps its own; write {owner} for your name.
strings.p_builtin_h: For the saved language, answer style and name. Save first if you just changed them.
strings.p_replace_body: The editor already has text. It will be replaced by the built-in prompt.
strings.f_knowledge: Notes the AI may answer from
strings.f_knowledge_ph:
e.g. Parcels: leave them at the front desk.
Opening hours: Monday to Friday, 9 to 6.
strings.f_knowledge_h: Facts callers may ask about, one per line. The AI must not make up anything that is not written here.
strings.g_blocked_d: Played when a call from the Blacklist or a hidden number is turned away. Manage the Blacklist in “Contacts”.
strings.b_help: End a number with * to block every number that starts the same way, e.g. 0800* (at least 3 digits, not counting leading zeros).
strings.reject_decline: Hang up while it rings (the call never connects)
strings.reject_announce: Answer, play “not available”, then hang up
strings.f_reject_voice_h: The announcement is spoken in the language chosen above.
strings.g_notify_d: Get a message when a call comes in, and the summary when it ends.
strings.f_notify_on_h: Off: nothing is sent to any channel.
strings.n_empty: No channels yet. Add one to get call summaries on your phone.
strings.n_ctl_h: Check calls, have the AI call someone and handle to-dos right from this chat. Send /help for the commands.
strings.n_ctl_users_h: In a group, list who may give commands, or nobody can. In a private chat you can leave this empty. Your user ID: ask @userinfobot.
strings.rc_desc: First switch on “Take commands from this chat” in a channel above.
strings.rc_env: Take commands in the Telegram chat set by environment variables
strings.rc_env_h: The bot and chat of TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID. TELEGRAM_CONTROL_USERS limits who may give commands.
strings.rc_errands: AI calls per chat per hour
strings.rc_errands_h: 0 = no AI calls from chats. At most 30.
strings.rc_msgs_h: Past this, that chat gets no more answers for the rest of the minute.
strings.mcp_desc: Lets AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT look up your calls and to-dos. Leave it off if you don't need it.
strings.mcp_on_h: Works only when this is on and the token below is set. The address is the console address plus /mcp.
strings.mcp_tok_h: Enter this token in the AI tool (as a Bearer token).
strings.mcp_calls: May it ask the AI to place calls?
strings.mcp_c_confirm: Yes, but ask me in a chat first
strings.mcp_calls_h: “Ask me first” needs a chat that takes commands.
strings.mcp_origins_h: Only for AI tools that run in a web page: one address per line, e.g. https://app.example. Otherwise leave empty.
strings.hint_telegram: Create a bot with @BotFather and paste its token. Chat ID: @userinfobot tells you yours; for a group use the group's ID and add the bot to it. Send the bot a message once so it is allowed to write to you.
strings.hint_discord: Notifications: fill in a Webhook URL (channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks → New Webhook → Copy Webhook URL) or the bot's token with the channel ID; one is enough. To get them in a private message, put your own ID where the channel ID goes. Chat commands: fill in the bot's token and the channel ID, and turn on Message Content Intent for the bot.
strings.hint_slack: Notifications: copy an Incoming Webhook URL (Mattermost too) or fill in the bot token with the channel ID; one is enough. Chat commands (Slack only): turn on Socket Mode, then fill in the bot token (xoxb-), the app-level token (xapp-) and the channel ID.
strings.hint_line: LINE Developers console → your Messaging API channel: issue a channel access token and copy your user ID (starts with U). Add the bot as a friend first. LINE Notify was shut down in 2025; this replaces it.
strings.hint_ntfy: Pick a topic name that is hard to guess and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. Leave the server empty for ntfy.sh. A token is only needed for protected topics.
strings.hint_gotify: In Gotify: Apps → Create application, then copy its token. The server URL is the address of your Gotify server.
strings.hint_bark: Open the Bark app on your iPhone and copy the device key from the sample URL. Leave the server empty to use the public one.
strings.hint_pushover: Create an application at pushover.net to get the API token. Your user key is on the Pushover dashboard.
strings.hint_wecom: In the WeCom group: add a group bot, then copy its webhook URL.
strings.hint_dingtalk: Group settings → Bots → add a custom bot and copy the webhook URL. If you chose “Sign” as its security setting, paste the secret (starts with SEC).
strings.hint_feishu: Group settings → Bots → Add bot → Custom bot, then copy the webhook URL. Do not turn on signature verification.
strings.hint_serverchan: Copy your SendKey from the ServerChan website.
strings.hint_matrix: Your homeserver (e.g. https://matrix.org), an access token of the sending account, and the ID of a room that account has joined (starts with !).
strings.hint_gmail: Your Gmail address and an app password (Google Account → Security → 2-Step Verification → App passwords). Not your normal password.
strings.hint_apprise: The notify URL of your Apprise API server, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. A tag limits which of its services get the message.
strings.hint_webhook: Any URL that accepts a JSON POST with event, title, body and data. Handy for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.
strings.hint_teams: In Teams: the channel's … menu → Workflows → “Post to a channel when a webhook request is received”, finish the steps and copy the URL it gives you. The old Office 365 connectors are retired.
strings.hint_googlechat: In Google Chat: open the space → Apps & integrations → Webhooks → Add webhook, then copy its URL. Needs a Google Workspace account.
strings.hint_rocketchat: Administration → Workspace → Integrations → New → Incoming: turn it on, pick the channel and copy the webhook URL.
strings.hint_zulip: Personal settings → Bots → Add a new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic) and enter its email and API key as email:key. Target: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone), or one or more emails for a direct message.
strings.hint_webex: Create a bot at developer.webex.com and copy its access token. Add the bot to a space and enter the room ID, or enter a person's email.
strings.hint_nextcloud: Your Nextcloud address, your user name and an app password (Settings → Security) written as user:password, and the conversation token: the last part of the conversation's link.
strings.hint_synology: In Synology Chat: Integration → Incoming Webhooks → Create, then copy the webhook URL. On your own network, the http:// address on port 5000 avoids certificate errors.
strings.hint_signal: Needs your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number. Enter the server address, the registered number in international format (+…) and the recipients: numbers or group IDs, separated by commas.
strings.hint_pushbullet: pushbullet.com → Settings → Account → Create Access Token. Leave the target empty to push to all your devices, or enter a device ID or an email.
strings.hint_pushplus: Log in at pushplus.plus and copy your token. A group code sends to that group; empty sends only to you.
strings.hint_pushdeer: Open the PushDeer app, add a key and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public one.
strings.hint_wxpusher: Simplest: a simple push token (SPT_…) from the WxPusher website, with no target. Or your app's appToken (AT_…) with user IDs (UID_…) or topic IDs, separated by commas.
strings.hint_chanify: In the Chanify app, create a token for this sender and copy it. Leave the server empty to use the public one.
strings.hint_smtp: Any mail server with TLS: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The login is also the sender. Use an app password if your provider offers one.
strings.hint_homeassistant: Your Home Assistant address, a long-lived access token (Profile → Security) and the notify service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (listed under Developer tools → Actions).
strings.hint_ifttt: ifttt.com/maker_webhooks → Documentation shows your key. Create an applet “If Webhooks: Receive a web request” with the same event name; value1 is the title and value2 the message.
strings.f_public_url_h: Links in notifications use this address. Empty = the one shown in grey; with Docker, or to reach it from outside your home, type your own.
strings.use_this_url: Use the address of this page: {url}
strings.g_summary_d: After each call the AI writes a short summary. There is normally nothing to set up here.
strings.f_sum_base_h: Any OpenAI-compatible service works, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.
strings.f_sum_provider_h: Uses your Gemini key by default. To use another service, choose “Another service”.
strings.f_cal_suggest_h: When a call settles a date (a delivery, an appointment), the summary comes with an “add to calendar” link.
strings.f_appt_mode_h: When a caller wants to set a time, the AI does not agree on the spot; it says it will check and get back to them. You then press Accept or Decline under “To do” on the Calls page, or in the notification.
strings.f_appt_sms_h: After you decide, the phone that took the call texts the caller (mobile numbers only). Off: the AI calls them back instead.
strings.f_appt_reply_h: Automatic: a text to a mobile, an AI call-back to a landline. Hidden numbers and numbers that can't be called back (abroad, toll-free and the like) get no reply.
strings.f_think_h: Only for models with “thinking” in their name. Low answers fastest.
strings.ph_none: Plug the phone in with a USB data cable, turn on USB debugging and open the app.
strings.ph_unauth: Waiting for permission: unlock the phone and accept the “Allow USB debugging?” prompt.
strings.ph_offline: Offline: unplug the cable and plug it in again.
strings.ph_noapp: The Bageo app is not installed on this phone.
strings.ph_link_ok: USB link is up and the app is installed
strings.ph_link_bad: The USB link is not set up yet. Wait a few seconds.
strings.usb_off: The USB helper is turned off
strings.usb_off_d: Phones connect to Bageo over the network instead.
strings.usb_noadb_d: Phones on USB cannot be set up automatically. Install the Android platform-tools or set ADB_BIN.
strings.chk_key_bad: Add your key so the AI can talk.
strings.chk_owner_bad: Tell the AI what callers call you.
strings.chk_prompt_bad: Answer a few questions in “About you” so the AI sounds more like you.
strings.chk_phone_bad: No phone is connected right now. See “Phones” on this page.
strings.chk_notify_bad: Add a channel to get call summaries on your phone.
strings.chk_summary_bad: Needs a Gemini key or another summary service.
strings.chk_all: Everything is ready. Call your phone's number to try it.
strings.ev_vm_end_hangup: Caller hung up while leaving a message
strings.ev_vm_confirm_timeout: No answer about how to reply
strings.ev_vm_contact_readback_timeout: No answer when the contact was read back
strings.ev_vm_contact_rejected: Caller said the contact was wrong
strings.ev_vm_reply_phone_confirmed: Caller asked for a call back
strings.ev_gemini_zero_delivery_to_voicemail: AI sent no sound, went to voicemail
strings.ev_gemini_delivery_fail_to_voicemail: AI audio could not be played, went to voicemail
strings.ev_call_waiting_rejected: Came in during another call, turned away as busy
strings.ev_ivr_hangup: Recording or voice menu: hung up
strings.err_sms_not_retryable: This text can't be sent again: the appointment isn't decided yet, or the text already went out.
strings.err_no_calendar: This call has no calendar suggestion.
strings.err_no_audio: This call has no recording of that kind.
strings.err_open_failed: The recording could not be opened.
strings.err_unknown_background: This background sound is not available.
strings.err_background_missing: The sound file for this background is missing.
strings.err_preview_failed: The sample could not be made. Check the Gemini API key and try again.
strings.err_bad_request: Bageo did not understand the request.
strings.err_save_failed: The settings could not be written to disk.
strings.err_fulfill_failed: The task could not be carried out.
strings.err_unknown_channel: Bageo does not know this notification service.
strings.err_bad_url: “{field}” must start with http:// or https://.
strings.err_auth_failed: The service refused the token or password.
strings.err_service_not_found: The service does not know this address or token.
strings.err_http_error: The service answered with an error.
strings.err_service_error: The service reported a problem with the message.
strings.err_room_encrypted: This room is encrypted, and Bageo cannot read encrypted rooms. Use a room without encryption.
strings.err_blocked_address: Bageo won't send to this address. Enter your notification service's own address.
strings.err_network_error: The service could not be reached.
strings.f_mdns_name_h: Devices on the same network can open the console at http://name.local. Letters, digits and hyphens only. Empty = off.
strings.cu_qr_h: Scan the code with your phone's camera to open the console there.
strings.cu_local: Only this computer can open this address.
strings.cu_qr_alt: QR code of the console address
strings.a2hs_title: Add this page to your home screen. Next time, just tap the icon.
strings.a2hs_ios: iPhone and iPad: Share → Add to Home Screen (Safari).
strings.a2hs_android: Android: Chrome menu ⋮ → Add to Home screen.
strings.a2hs_desktop: Computer: the install icon at the right of the address bar (Chrome, Edge).
strings.cu_ip: Phones that cannot open .local addresses (some older Android phones) use:
strings.ph_mode_normal: Normal phone: calls ring, the AI does not answer
strings.ph_need_update: Update the Bageo app on this phone to switch it from here
strings.ph_to_normal_b: Calls to this phone will no longer be answered by the AI. It rings like a normal phone and someone has to pick up. You can switch back at any time.
strings.ph_now_normal: It is now a normal phone
strings.ph_now_ai: The AI answers this phone again
strings.ph_incall_wait: On a call: switch after it ends
strings.pm_err_in_call: the phone is on a call. Try again after it ends
strings.pm_err_busy: the phone is still finishing the previous switch
strings.pm_err_no_root: the Bageo module is not running on the phone. In Magisk or KernelSU, check that Bageo Uplink is enabled, then restart the phone
strings.pm_err_save_failed: the phone could not save the mode
strings.pm_err_dialer_failed: the phone could not change its default phone app
strings.pm_err_screening_failed: the phone could not change its call screening setting
strings.pm_err_dnd_failed: the phone could not change Do Not Disturb
strings.pm_err_volume_failed: the phone could not turn its ringer back on
strings.pm_err_invalid_mode: the phone did not recognize this mode
strings.pm_err_unsupported: the app on the phone is too old. Update it first
strings.pm_err_timeout: Result not confirmed yet. Refresh this page in a moment.
strings.pm_err_failed: something went wrong on the phone
strings.er_new: Ask the AI to make a call
strings.er_new_d: The AI calls, takes care of it and tells you how it went. During the call you can read along and tell the AI what to do at any time.
strings.er_to_ph: Type a name to find a contact, or a phone number
strings.er_no_match: No contact by that name. You can also type the number.
strings.er_need_pick: Pick a contact from the list, or type a phone number.
strings.er_task_ph:
e.g. Book a table for 4 tomorrow at 7 pm under Lee, non-smoking; if 7 is full, 7:30 to 8 is fine too
or: Ask which day this weekend, Saturday or Sunday, suits him for dinner
strings.er_task_h: Say what you want done and what you can accept. If the AI is unsure during the call, it asks you here.
strings.er_id_assistant_d: The AI says it is calling for you, as your assistant.
strings.er_phone_auto: Automatic (a free line that can call this number)
strings.er_phone_normal: {name} (normal phone mode, the AI can't use it)
strings.er_phone_h: A phone in normal phone mode can't make AI calls. Switch it back to AI answering on the System page.
strings.er_pre_d: Add them so the AI doesn't have to stop and ask during the call.
strings.er_started: Handed to the AI. It is calling now.
strings.er_queued: Queued. The AI calls as soon as a phone is free.
strings.er_empty_body: Write above what needs doing. The AI calls, handles it and tells you the result.
strings.er_redial_h: If it doesn't get through (no answer, busy, voicemail), it redials {gap} s later until someone answers, for up to {min} minutes.
strings.er_redial_wait: Redial until answered: try {n} didn't get through, calling again at {time}
strings.er_live_wait: Dialing, waiting for them to pick up…
strings.er_watching: You're watching: when unsure, the AI asks you first.
strings.er_q_over: Time's up, the AI will decide
strings.er_tell_ph: e.g. Tell them 8 pm works too
strings.er_hangup_b: The AI ends the call right away. The errand may not be done yet.
strings.er_unconfirmed: Not confirmed by the other side
strings.er_options: Their options. Pick one and the AI calls back with it:
strings.er_fu_title: Reply, and have the AI call again
strings.er_fu_h: The AI calls {who} again and replies with this.
strings.er_delete_b: It leaves this list. The call records stay.
strings.er_err_not_allowed: The AI can't call this number (emergency, special or premium-rate number).
strings.er_err_no_sim_for_country: No phone has a SIM that can call this country's numbers.
strings.er_err_sim_other_country: This SIM is from a different country than the number.
strings.er_abroad_body: The SIM you picked is from {sim}, but the number is in {dest}. Your carrier may charge for an international call.
strings.er_err_sim_unknown: This phone hasn't taken a call yet, so the system doesn't know which SIMs it has. Call it once, then try again.
strings.er_err_no_task: Write what the AI should take care of.
strings.er_err_task_too_long: That's too long: at most 1,000 characters.
strings.er_err_no_phone: No AI phone is available right now (none connected, or all in normal phone mode).
strings.er_err_not_found: That errand or contact no longer exists.
strings.er_err_busy: This call is still queued or on the line. Try again after it ends.
strings.er_err_not_on_call: The call has ended, so the AI can't pass this on.
strings.f_er_identity_h: Who the AI says it is when it calls for you. Each errand can still pick its own.
strings.ct_kind_whitelist: Whitelist (family and friends; can be put through to you)
strings.ct_kind_stall: Stall list (the AI wastes their time from the start)
strings.ct_kind_help: How calls from this number are handled.
strings.wl_desc: Choose who can reach you and when. This does not replace emergency services.
strings.wl_m_direct: Don't answer: send to your phone
strings.wl_m_emergency: AI answers, puts you through if urgent
strings.f_wl_num_h: The number the phone calls when something is urgent.
strings.f_ui_pw_h: Once set, the console asks for it when opened (once per browser). Needed to open the console on your phone or another computer.
strings.pw_setup_body: Set a password if you will open this console from outside your home network. You can change it later in Settings.
strings.pw_setup_help: This browser remembers it. You will be asked again on a new device.
strings.pw_setup_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
strings.n_ctl_users_h_discord: In a server channel, list who may give commands, or nobody can. In a private message you can leave this empty. Your ID: turn on Developer Mode, then right-click your name → Copy User ID.
strings.n_ctl_users_h_slack: In a channel, list who may give commands, or nobody can. In a direct message you can leave this empty. Your member ID: open your profile → ⋮ → Copy member ID.
strings.n_ctl_users_h_matrix: In a room with other people, list who may give commands, or nobody can. A room with only you and the bot can stay empty. A Matrix ID looks like @name:matrix.org.
strings.n_ctl_h_slack: Check calls, have the AI call someone and handle to-dos right from this chat. Send "@your bot /help" for the commands.
strings.n_ctl_h_matrix: Check calls, have the AI call someone and handle to-dos right from this chat. Send "@your bot /help" for the commands.
strings.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_ai_ended: Urgent: the AI dropped off while calling you
strings.urg_why_phone: the phone could not place the call
strings.urg_why_scam_words: the caller sounded like a scam, so you were not called
strings.er_err_empty_text: Write what you want to say.
strings.er_err_text_too_long: That's too long. Please shorten it.
strings.er_err_question_closed: That question was already answered or has timed out.
strings.d_del_call_b: Its summary, transcript, and recording will be permanently deleted.
strings.calls_clear_b: All finished calls and their recordings will be permanently deleted. Calls in progress will stay.
strings.err_call_in_progress: Wait until the call ends before deleting it.
strings.ph_forget_b: Removes this offline phone from the list. Past call records stay.
strings.err_device_online: Disconnect this phone first before deleting it.
strings.err_device_in_call: Wait until the call on this phone ends.
strings.bl_mode: When someone on the Blacklist calls:
strings.ct_bad_prefix: Only Blacklist numbers can end with *, with at least 3 digits before it, not counting leading zeros.
strings.sms_empty_d: Texts your phones receive show up here once the SMS forwarder is running.
strings.sms_pick: Pick a conversation, or press “New message”.
strings.sms_no_line: No phone can send texts right now.
strings.sms_no_reply: You can't reply to this sender.
strings.sms_err_old_app: This phone's app is too old to send texts.
strings.sms_err_permission: The phone's app may not send texts. Allow it on the phone.
strings.sms_err_generic: The phone could not send it.
strings.sms_err_number: Check the number and try again.
strings.sms_err_sim_not_found: The chosen SIM card is not in the phone.
strings.f_keep_h: Calls and recordings, texts, errands and to-dos older than this are deleted automatically.
strings.f_keep_h_phone: Calls and recordings, errands and to-dos older than this are deleted automatically.
strings.f_phone_wifi: Phones can also connect over Wi-Fi
strings.f_phone_wifi_h: On: a phone plugged in by USB once keeps working over Wi-Fi after you unplug it. Off: phones connect by USB only.
strings.f_repair_h: Use this if a phone was lost or someone else used it.
strings.repair_b: Phones on Wi-Fi are disconnected. Plug each one in by USB once more to connect it again.
strings.repair_done: Phones paired again. Plug each Wi-Fi phone in by USB once.
strings.g_backup_d: Backup files hold your keys and passwords. Keep them where only you can get them.
strings.bk_dir_h: Leave empty to use the default location. Otherwise type the full path of a folder.
strings.bk_calls: Include call records, recordings and texts
strings.bk_item_numbers: Your own number notes and scam numbers
strings.bk_warn_newer_version: This backup comes from a newer Bageo. Some settings may not work here.
strings.bk_warn_plain_settings_file: This is a plain settings file, so only settings are restored.
strings.bk_warn_password: The console password will change to the one in this backup.
strings.bk_dlg_note: Before restoring, Bageo saves your current settings to a separate file.
strings.bk_done_apply: Restored. Your previous settings were saved as {name}.
strings.bk_done_restart: Reopen Bageo for everything to take effect.
strings.err_backup_dir_unwritable: Can't save to that folder. Pick another folder and type its full path.
strings.bk_err_busy: A backup or restore is already under way. Try again when it finishes.
strings.bk_err_dir_unwritable: Can't save to the backup folder. Pick another folder.
strings.bk_err_disk_full: The disk is full. Free up some space or pick another folder.
strings.bk_err_io: The backup didn't work. Try again in a moment.
strings.bk_err_not_backup: This isn't a Bageo backup file. Pick another file.
strings.bk_err_damaged: This backup file is damaged. Try another one.
strings.bk_err_too_new: This backup comes from a newer Bageo than this one. Install the newer version first.
strings.bk_err_too_large: The file is over 200 MB. Use a settings-only backup instead.
strings.bk_err_expired: This took too long. Choose the file again.
strings.bk_err_call_active: A call is in progress. Try again when it ends.
strings.bk_err_not_local: The folder can only be opened on the computer that runs Bageo.
strings.bk_exp_title: What do you want to export?
strings.bk_exp_keys_h: Turn this on when you move to another computer. Leave it off when you show your settings to someone.
strings.bk_exp_keys_h_phone: Turn this on when you move to a new phone. Leave it off when you show your settings to someone.
strings.bk_warn_keys_kept: The keys, passwords and connections on this computer stay as they are.
strings.bk_warn_connections: Where notifications go and who can control Bageo remotely will change to what this file says.
strings.bk_err_need_password: To download this, open the console on the computer that runs Bageo, or set a console password first.
strings.bk_err_bad_request: Something is wrong with the file or the request. Choose the file again and retry.
strings.bk_err_not_found: That backup file is no longer there. Reload the page and pick another one.
strings.bk_encrypt_h: Protects the copies you keep on an external drive, in a cloud folder or on a network folder.
strings.bk_encrypt_h_phone: Protects the copies you save to the cloud or send elsewhere.
strings.bk_pw_h: If you forget the password, these backups can't be opened, and Bageo can't recover them either.
strings.bk_exp_enc: Encrypt this file with a password
strings.bk_unlock_t: This backup is encrypted. Enter its password.
strings.bk_err_backup_password_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
strings.err_backup_password_short: The backup password needs at least 8 characters.
strings.err_backup_password_missing: Set a backup password before you turn on encryption.
strings.cu_lan: Phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi can open the console at this address.
strings.cu_lan_nopw: Phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi can use this address. Set a console password before opening it on another device.
strings.err_password_too_short: The password needs at least 8 characters.
strings.err_too_many_tries: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in a minute.
strings.bk_del_b: Once deleted, it can't be brought back.
strings.bk_del_need_password: To delete it, open the console on the computer that runs Bageo, or set a console password first.
strings.f_wl_mode_h_direct: This phone doesn't answer; your carrier forwards the call to your number and the AI stays silent. First switch the phone to normal phone and dial **67*your number# to turn on forward-when-busy, or callers reach voicemail.
strings.f_wl_mode_h_emergency: The AI answers first; if it's urgent, it asks the caller to hold and calls you, and once you pick up you talk to them directly. If you don't answer, the AI says you'll call back. Without your number, you only get an alert.
strings.wl_call_terms_1: The AI can get it wrong: it may not call you about something truly urgent, or may call you when it isn't.
strings.wl_call_terms_2: This does not replace emergency services. If a life is at risk, the caller should call the local emergency number directly.
strings.wl_call_terms_3: The call to you is made from this phone's SIM. Your carrier charges as usual; international or roaming calls may cost more.
strings.wl_call_terms_4: After you are put through, the call is recorded according to your settings. You are responsible for following local laws about telling people they are recorded.
strings.wl_call_terms_5: The call to you may not get through. You use this at your own risk; Bageo and its developers are not liable for any loss.
strings.f_wl_who_others_h: Includes hidden numbers. A stranger saying it's urgent may be a scam; turn this on only if you need it.
strings.f_wl_who_h: People on the Blacklist or the Stall list are never forwarded.
strings.ippair_title: Pair a phone by IP address
strings.ippair_h: Use this when Bageo runs in Docker or on another computer and the phone can't be plugged in.
strings.ippair_step: In the Bageo app on the phone, tap "Connect by IP address" and enter:
strings.ippair_docker: Enter the IP of the Docker host
strings.ippair_need_password: To get a pairing code from another device, set a console password first, or open the console on the computer that runs Bageo.
strings.err_phone_wifi_off: Turn on "Phones can also connect over Wi-Fi" first.
strings.f_home_country_h: The AI follows this region's way of speaking and everyday habits. Automatic: from the phone number.

strings.vp_r_io: Can't save it. Check there is free disk space.
strings.vp_r_busy: Still working on it. Try again in a moment.
strings.ts_1_d: Like a close friend: warm, relaxed and chatty.
strings.ts_2_d: Kind and warm, a bit more relaxed than usual.
strings.ts_3_d: Like most people on the phone: not too casual, not stiff.
strings.ts_4_d: Polite and careful, as with someone you don't know well.
strings.ts_5_d: Short and clear, like a business call.
strings.ts_custom: Your own prompt is in use, so the talk style is not applied.
strings.ts_scene: Change the view outside the window
strings.ab_suggested: Talk style set to “{level}” to match. You can change it.
strings.ab_work: Your work or day, in one line
strings.ab_work_ph: e.g. Sales at a trading company
strings.ab_say_h: Press Enter or add a comma after each phrase. The AI uses your phrases now and then and avoids the others.
strings.ab_asks: What to ask for in a message
strings.ab_parcel: Where should parcels and deliveries go?
strings.ab_parcel_ph0: e.g. Leave it at the front desk
strings.ab_extra: Anything else the AI should know
strings.lang_unreviewed: (not yet checked by a native speaker)

strings.lang_fallback: This language isn't available right now, so calls will be in English for now.

strings.lang_unreviewed_note: This language has not been checked by a native speaker yet.
strings.f_extras_auto_h: Downloads your browser or SIM languages and local artwork straight from GitHub when signed in.
strings.ex_desc: All 70 languages work for calls right away. Download a language pack to also show menus or notifications in it. Downloaded straight from GitHub.
strings.ex_r_in_use: Can't delete while selected in settings.
strings.m_ai_on_desc: Incoming calls are answered and screened by AI.
strings.m_ai_off_desc: Original phone mode restored; calls ring normally.
strings.m_empty_calls: When calls come in, summaries, transcripts, and recordings appear here.
strings.m_chk_module_d: Enable the Bageo module in Magisk or KernelSU and reboot.
strings.m_chk_perms_d: Needed to answer calls, read caller ID, and show notifications.
strings.m_chk_dialer_d: Set to Bageo while AI answers; restored automatically when off.
strings.m_chk_screening_d: Keeps incoming calls silent while AI answers.
strings.m_chk_dnd_d: Lets Bageo restore your ringer cleanly when switching modes.
strings.m_chk_battery_d: Prevents Android from putting Bageo to sleep while idle.
strings.m_er_need_ai: Turn on AI answering first so Bageo can place this call.
strings.m_sync_desc: Import contacts from this phone so caller names show up automatically.

strings.m_sg_style_d: Tone slider, ring delay, background sound, and unknown callers
strings.m_sg_about_d: Status note, frequent callers, phrases, and info AI can share
strings.m_sg_scam_d: Scam checks, time-wasting mode, and rejection voice
strings.m_sg_phone_d: Whitelist handling, daily sound, DND sync, and local notifications
strings.m_sg_notify_d: Notification channels, appointment confirmation, and calendar
strings.m_sg_data_d: Theme, app language, backups, updates, and voice downloads
strings.m_sg_adv_d: Permissions check, SIM cards, Wi-Fi console, and version
strings.m_sg_adv_d_phone: Permissions check, SIM cards and version
strings.m_wl_urgent: AI screens first, pop up takeover when urgent
strings.m_wl_ring: Ring this phone directly for Whitelist
strings.m_wl_forward: Forward or merge to another number
strings.m_wl_ai: Let AI handle all calls normally
strings.m_daily_sound_h: Keep message, media, and alarm sounds audible; mute calls only.
strings.m_summary_notif_h: Show a notification on this phone with the summary and call-back button.
strings.m_persist_notif: Show ongoing notification while AI is active
strings.m_dnd_auto: Auto-switch AI with Do Not Disturb
strings.m_dnd_auto_h: Turn AI answering on with Do Not Disturb and off when DND ends.
strings.m_dnd_any: Trigger on any Do Not Disturb mode
strings.m_chk_sms_d: Lets Bageo text callers whether their booking went through.
strings.er_need_phone: Your phone isn't ready yet. Wait a few seconds; if this stays, reopen the app.
strings.bk_err_read_failed: Couldn't read this file. Please pick it again.
strings.bk_app_note: Backups are kept inside Bageo and are deleted with the app. To keep one, tap “Download” to save it on your phone.

strings.ph_fit_unsupported: This phone cannot send the AI's voice into calls
strings.ph_fit_ask: Did you hear the AI's voice on the last call?
strings.ph_fit_retest: Other call audio settings are ready. Call this phone again to test them.
strings.ph_fit_noted: Noted: this phone's call audio has a problem
strings.er_when_later: At a set date and time
strings.er_when_later_d: It dials at that time. Pick the line to call from.
strings.er_scheduled_ok: Scheduled. It dials by itself at that time.
strings.er_err_need_time: Pick the date and time to call.
strings.er_err_past_time: That time has passed. Pick a later one.
strings.er_err_too_far: You can schedule up to {days} days ahead.
strings.er_err_need_line: A scheduled call needs a line to call from.

strings.er_err_time_skipped: That time doesn't exist: the clock skips it for summer time. Pick another time.
